name: Unchained Hunger
effectText: Target 2 face-up monsters anywhere on the field, including an "Unchained Soul" Link Monster you control; immediately after this effect resolves, Link Summon 1 Fiend Link Monster using only those 2 monsters. If this Set card is destroyed by card effect: You can Special Summon 1 "Unchained" monster from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Unchained Hunger" once per turn.
